narrative.title: Locating a Cassette in a Wrapped Carousel
narrative.scenario: A carousel of tape cassettes is arranged in ascending order, but the whole ring was advanced by an unknown number of slots, so the sequence reads like a shifted ascending run. The retrieval arm must still find one cassette in a handful of probes. Either identify the requested cassette's slot or declare it absent.
narrative.inputFormat: An array nums of n distinct integers, sorted ascending then rotated at an unknown pivot, and an integer target.
narrative.outputFormat: The index of target in nums, or -1 when target is absent.
constraints: All values in nums are unique
An O(log n) algorithm is required

testCases.explanation: The wrap point sits between 7 and 0, and probing halves that still respect order locates 0 at index 4.
Neither wrapped half can contain 3, so the search exhausts its space and reports -1.

hintLevels: Level 1: Splitting a wrapped ring at any point always leaves at least one side as a clean ascending run.
Level 2: Identify which side of the probe is the sorted run, then decide from the target's bounds whether it can live in that run or must be in the other half.
Level 3: The inclusive equality at the probe and the closed range checks against the sorted run's end values are what stop the search from discarding the target's half.
